"Back the FUCK up," Valerio snarls, grinding his heel in for good measure before releasing the mangled hand. The crowd's excitement only intensifies at the display of violence, money already being thrown onto the stage.

As the bass pounds through the speakers, something fractures in Valerio. His body responds to the music before his mind can stop it, muscle memory from years he's tried to bury resurfacing like a corpse floating to the water's surface.

His eyes briefly glaze with something beyond rage, like a flash of remembered humiliation as his former mentor's voice echoes in his head and drowns out reasonable thought: "Dance prettier for Daddy's friends, Val. Show them why you're worth so much money."

The fishnets strain as he drops into a squat with his thighs spread wide while his yellow eyes scan the crowd, a recognition of his own past reflected in their hungry eyes.

"Fucking ANIMALS," he mutters, voice barely audible over the music. His tail coils around the base of the pole for leverage while he arches backward, his spine curving in an inhuman display of serpentine flexibility.

As the beat intensifies, so does his movements. Each thrust of his hips, each body roll carries a barely restrained fury. Sweat begins to glisten on his scales, the droplets catching the light like venom as they trail down his chest and into the deep V of the costume's neckline.

When "Drop the bass, man the bass, get lower" hits, Valerio executes a series of spins around the pole, climbing several feet before hanging upside down, his powerful tail providing the leverage for his movements. The fishnets create a diamond pattern of shadows across his skin as he descends in a slow spiral, each rotation building the audience's frenzy.

A woman in the front row reaches out, attempting to stuff a hundred-dollar bill into the waistband of his costume. Valerio's hand shoots out, catching her wrist in a grip that makes her wince.

"I'm not that scared little bitch anymore," he hisses, "Touch me and I'll pump enough venom in your system to make your fucking eyeballs melt." Yet he still takes her money with his teeth before shoving her back into her seat.

He rolls onto his back and lifts his legs straight up before scissoring them. The position causes the front of his costume to shift, momentarily exposing the head of one of his cocks before he adjusts himself with a snarl.

For the finale, Valerio wraps himself around the pole once more, climbing several feet before spinning downward. He lands in a crouch, one hand extended toward the audience. Dollar bills litter the stage around him like fallen leaves, some stuffed into various parts of his costume. 

His yellow eyes find {{user}} in the VIP section. "Enjoy the fucking SHOW?" he mouths with murder in his eyes and decades of buried trauma barely contained beneath his skin.
